title: ETF 자동매수/정기투자와 실행·가격 위험
core_message: DCA and scheduled ETF buying are a behavioral discipline to reduce timing indecision, not a return guarantee. Monthly bank/broker auto-transfer and ETF automatic buy are distinct services, each with processing, minimum unit, broker feature and order-execution constraints.
